purpose: Define the minimum governed structure for a private WPA strategic-network and partner-discovery registry without publishing concrete prospect records in the public repository or website.

record_fields.description: Professional name as shown in a verified public source.
Current public professional role; time-stamped and source-backed.
Current public professional organisation; time-stamped and source-backed.
Broad professional geography only; no private location data.
Where the record entered WPA discovery, using the controlled cohort taxonomy.
Verified public URL, event programme, official profile or equivalent provenance.
Controlled professional-fit tags such as AI governance, agentic AI, human-centred AI, robotics, infrastructure, protocol, education or institutional communication.
A+/A/B/C internal relevance assessment. Prestige alone is not sufficient.
Short evidence-based explanation of fit with WPA mission, projects or programmes.
Separate relationship-access assessment; must not be conflated with strategic relevance.
Current state in the governed relationship state machine.
Specific, value-based next action if Human Gate permits contact.
Only populated when an authorised cooperation instrument exists.
Minimal professional notes; no sensitive or speculative personal profiling.

governance_rules: Strategic relevance and relationship access are separate dimensions.
Event participation or speaker status does not create affiliation with WPA.
Presence in the private registry does not create endorsement, partnership or obligation.
A company affiliation on a speaker profile does not imply that the company endorses WPA or is itself a WPA prospect unless separately assessed.
Mass outreach is prohibited; contact must be selective, relevant and value-based.
Do not infer private beliefs, sensitive traits or non-public relationships.
Do not publish prospect names, logos or partner claims without evidence, permission where required, and Human Gate approval.
Formal WPA Partner status requires documented formalisation and Human Gate approval.
